goal: Recognizable hollow vase whose silhouette follows the illustration
geometry_plan: assume 1 px ~ 0.4 mm so the vase is 200 mm tall
measure half-width of the silhouette at 8 heights and use them as (radius, height) spline points
close the profile with lines to the axis, make_face on Plane.XZ, revolve about Axis.Z
hollow with offset(amount=-2.5, openings=top face) to keep the mouth open
